Tabs from ui-components shows a list of tabs, along the top of their panels or down their left side, and the panel of the tab selected. Click a tab, or give it the focus with Tab and move with the arrow keys, Home and End. The panels of all tabs are in the page, so switching needs no request and keeps what you typed in each.

The documents are closable: close one with its ×, with Delete while its tab has the focus, or with the middle button. Each change you make to a document reaches the server by the Ajax behavior of its text area, and the server marks its tab with a dot: changes not saved. Closing a tab with changes asks first, in a dialog, and closing it anyway puts its text back; the server then hears of the tab closed and forgets it. Save takes the mark away. The button before the × of a document is an action of the page: it shows what the server knows of the document in a popover, a bubble pointing at it, in the colors of the theme: in its main color when all is saved, amber with changes. A click outside, Escape or the button again closes it. New document adds a tab via Ajax without rendering the others, so what you typed in them stays.

The second tabs take any of nine designs, along the top or down the side: tabs, pills and underline; segmented, folder and lifted, made for tabs along the top; side bar, steps and cards, made for tabs down the side, which the gallery shows. All take their colors from the theme; with setSendToServer the server hears each tab you select, as the sentence below them says. Everything works under a strict Content Security Policy, without inline style.
This tab cannot be closed. The others are documents: type in one and the server hears it and marks its tab; save it and the mark goes. Close a document with changes, and you are asked first.
